title: ONE EDIT

scenes.vo: I thought I was fixing one edit.
scenes.shot: Enter the final three seconds of the same transformed vessel, withholding its paper origin.
scenes.purpose: Open inside the payoff and create a question about how it was made.

scenes.vo: Two cameras. One conversation. They refused to stay together.
scenes.shot: A retained moving conversation fills the frame. Two differently timed amber/violet waveform rows align below it.
scenes.purpose: Make sync understandable to a stranger through one human conversation, not interface instructions.

scenes.vo: Fix the timing. Lose the sound. Fix the sound. Break the render.
scenes.shot: The moving conversation and SYNC / SOUND / RENDER labels are interrupted by a physical dark shutter and a red FAILED lockup.
scenes.purpose: Each fix causes a consequence, building frustration.

scenes.vo: Some days, the only thing that finished was the error log.
scenes.shot: An archived graphic reconstruction of render errors sits in depth beside the illuminated word AGAIN. This is not an unmodified error screenshot.
scenes.purpose: Let a setback hurt; hold briefly rather than racing through a decorative code montage.

scenes.vo: Even the machines said no. But I couldn't leave it there.
scenes.shot: A large extruded zero on a dark stage with NO CAPACITY. The narration carries the setback; no quota email, archive date or GPU class is shown in this shot.
scenes.purpose: External constraint becomes the lowest point; persistence is the emotional turn.

scenes.vo: Then one door opened. And the question changed.
scenes.shot: The extruded zero and physical panels move aside to show retained generated yacht footage. 3000 milliGPU labels the historical capacity; this is not a new grant or 3000 physical GPUs.
scenes.purpose: A genuine quota grant and bounded execution earn the release of tension. 3000 milliGPU is capacity, not 3000 physical GPUs.

scenes.vo: What if the system could understand the story? Create the missing shot. Find the cut. Build the sound.
scenes.shot: STORY / SHOT / CUT / SOUND labels resolve over the retained conversation, then the retained generated yacht becomes the chosen source. This is an authored concept visualization, not a recording of a live Director plan.
scenes.purpose: Move from repairs to creative decisions, with real sources and editorial data.

scenes.vo: Bring it together. I didn't know I was building this.
scenes.shot: One continuous folded-paper hull and sail become timber and canvas while the workbench sinks into a deep ocean; the camera follows the same vessel.
scenes.purpose: Complete the opening world through connected visible geometry, material and scale change.

scenes.vo: The film you just watched was created by AutoPromote.
scenes.shot: The created-by sentence resolves on a dark dimensional field, with restrained camera movement. No live Studio UI/project recording is represented.
scenes.purpose: Land the promised self-referential payoff. Production receipts disclose assistant-directed story and source generation versus actual AutoPromote editing/rendering.

scenes.shot: Original exact logo contours emerge as titanium, optical-black, anodized-violet and glass layers; grazing light and a macro-to-lockup camera resolve at 3.2s, followed by a clean static hold.
scenes.purpose: A dedicated editable brand sequence, not a flat logo fade.

reviewFix: Remove empty holds; select completed late action from long raw takes; preserve full narration and replace old letter-scale ident.
